narr: Slow moving showers and thunderstorms amidst weak flow aloft resulted in flooding and flash flooding across portions of Montgomery County, Maryland. Localized rainfall totals of two to four inches in about 90 minutes were observed in portions of the county near the Potomac River towards I-270.
ev: Multiple vehicles driving into flooded roadway with at least 6 inches of water running along it. Occurred at River Road.
Around Kentsdale Drive and Bradley Boulevard, a car got stuck in moving water which was around 6 inches deep. Occupants safely got out.
River Road/MD-190 is closed in both directions between Persimmon Tree Road and Bradley Road where 6 inches of water was flowing across.
